description: An AI-powered interactive 3D map designed to help astronauts explore Mars. Using NASA data and artificial intelligence, the platform analyzes terrain, identifies potential hazards, highlights useful resources, and suggests suitable exploration routes. It combines immersive digital art, 3D visualization, and smart technology to create an engaging guide for future Mars missions.
summary: > Project NEBULART* is an AI-powered 3D Martian Survival Navigator designed to support astronauts and researchers during planetary exploration. Addressing the challenge of navigating treacherous extraterrestrial terrain, NEBULART transforms complex scientific data from NASA into an interactive, accessible 3D visual platform. The platform integrates real NASA datasets—including MOLA elevation models, HiRISE high-resolution surface imagery, CTX context maps, and THEMIS thermal data—to analyze surface conditions, detect steep slope hazards, and pinpoint subsurface water ice resources. Furthermore, a smart route planner computes safe traversability paths, while an integrated AI mission assistant provides real-time telemetry guidance. NEBULART bridges creativity, digital art, and space science to make Martian exploration safer and more intuitive.
details:
* *What it does / How it works:* NEBULART provides an interactive 3D digital environment representing Martian terrain (such as Jezero Crater). It features real-time AI hazard detection (identifying high-slope boulder fields), resource mapping (highlighting subsurface ice anomalies), a smart route recommendation algorithm, and a conversational AI mission assistant for crew telemetry support.

* *Benefits & Impact:* It drastically reduces exploration risks for astronauts by visualizing dangerous topographies beforehand, optimizing battery and energy consumption for rovers or suits, and streamlining resource acquisition (water ice).

* *Tools, Coding Languages, & Software Used:*

* Frontend & UI/UX: Figma, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Canvas API.

* 3D & Visual Design: Blender, Adobe Photoshop.

* Backend & AI Concepts: Python, Scikit-learn (for classification and traversability scoring models).

* Interactive Platform / Data Viz: Unity / CesiumJS frameworks concept.

* *Creativity & Team Considerations:* NEBULART merges advanced space data analytics with creative digital art ("Nebula" + "Art"), ensuring that complex scientific data is communicated through an engaging, user-friendly, and visually striking interface designed by our creative team (Basmala Eleraqi, Hend Gamal, and Hana Elghobashy).
